scope: Align roadmap search and track controls
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

roadmap--overview-compact-dark.png.task: Find work with a compact labeled toolbar that leaves room for dependencies.
roadmap--overview-compact-dark.png.observations: The toolbar is one labeled row at both sizes. Graph names remain readable at 100%, straight connections attach to the intended card edges, the unavailable dependency is dashed, and the blocked release is unconnected. Toolbar and nodes do not overlap.
